column13: THE TWO ROWS ABOVE ARE ONE DISAGREEMENT, not two. Taken alone this inventory is 0.49 of the submission on landfill methane and 17.74 times it on open burning - an apparent order-of-magnitude error in opposite directions on adjacent categories. Summed over the solid stream the ratio is 0.68, so what the two accounts mainly disagree about is the FATE SPLIT of the same waste: how much is collected to a disposal site against how much is burned where it falls. That is a question about collection statistics, not about an emission factor, and it is why neither individual ratio should be quoted as a level error. 4.C.1 is on the BTR side only and is carried here so the sum is complete
